faq.q: How do I block my lost card?
faq.a: Say 'block my card' here, use the app, or call 1800-000-0000 (24x7). Blocking is instant and free.

faq.q: How long does a new debit card take to arrive?
faq.a: New cards are dispatched within 2 working days and arrive in 5-7 working days.
Online NEFT and RTGS transfers are free. IMPS up to Rs 1 lakh costs Rs 5.

faq.q: How can I reset my net banking password?
faq.a: Use 'Forgot Password' on the login page; verify with OTP sent to your registered mobile.

faq.q: What documents are needed for a loan?
faq.a: PAN, Aadhaar, last 3 months salary slips, 6 months bank statement, and address proof.

faq.q: How do I dispute a transaction?
faq.a: Report within 30 days. We provisionally credit eligible disputes within 10 working days.

faq.q: What is the minimum balance for savings?
faq.a: Average monthly balance of Rs 5,000; a Rs 250 charge applies if not maintained.
Floating-rate home loans have zero prepayment charges; other loans 2% of prepaid amount.
FD interest is taxable; TDS of 10% applies above Rs 40,000 a year (Rs 50,000 for seniors). Submit Form 15G/15H if eligible.
Branches are open 10 AM to 4 PM, Monday to Saturday, except 2nd and 4th Saturdays.
